title: Richard Carvel — Complete
summary: "Richard Carvel — Complete" by Winston Churchill is a historical novel published in 1899. Set during the American Revolutionary era, it unfolds as the memoirs of an eighteenth-century Maryland gentleman. Young Richard Carvel navigates family betrayal, kidnapping by pirates, and the glittering corruption of London society. Torn between his loyalist grandfather and revolutionary convictions, and yearning for his elusive childhood love Dorothy Manners, Richard's adventures sweep from colonial Maryland to England and back as war approaches, testing both his political ideals and his heart.
